problemStatement: The movie rail and every existing manual witness capture deliberately draw the LONG span (manual-witness-hold-probe.mjs hardcodes the 18-waypoint z=14..22 detour, which is CG_ROUTE_LONG minus its first vertex). LONG is supported end to end by the fixed reference and therefore completes as routeClass 'fixed-reference'. No existing artefact can be re-read as a SHORT proof, so a SHORT lane must draw the short span itself and earn the held-reference class.

limitations: PREPARED, NOT RUN. Nothing here is evidence about the chapter. No browser, GPU, preview, dev server or build was used.

The SHORT completion is UNPROVEN until this lane is released and run on hardware; the hold reason and therefore the witness-vs-revision branch are predictions taken from the shipped unit suite, not measurements.

Running it requires root to publish: activeRole arrival-common-short-runtime in verifier-control.json, a current preview-ownership.json (url + indexSha256 + bundleSha256 + bundlePath + sourceManifestSha256), and an inherited EXCLUSIVE flock on fd 9 of the shared heavy lock. It refuses otherwise, before any browser.
The ch13-survey deep link is a labelled fixture. This lane can never support an earned-continuous-arrival, first-time-usability or naive-UX claim.
Route waypoints were read from frozen source, which is private knowledge a player does not have; this is an instrumentation lane, not a discoverability measurement.

The pinned cgContract copy still carries the scene-v2 SIGNED_CONTRACT_SHA256; its loadContract() is unused here and the lane binds to the scene-v3 bytes directly. That stale constant in the SHARED helper is reported, not fixed by this role.
The witness-return (vacate/re-enter) contingency and the ch13-common beat are out of this lane's scope.
